modelType: software reference electrical model with linked op-amp servo
topology: Ultra-Clean Class-A / crossover-free + bounded op-amp feedback/DC servo
frequencyResponse: inherits YURIKA DSP; amp deviation <= 0.02 dB from 20 Hz to 20 kHz in the reference model
notes: Power and P1dB figures are software-reference/equivalent values and do not mean the PC physically delivers this wattage or has a measured hardware P1dB.
The headroom extension lowers the internal nonlinear drive and restores unity level after the model, moving the modeled nonlinear onset upward without lookahead.
The linked op-amp subsystem is a bounded feedback/DC-servo software model, not a model of a named physical op-amp component.
Runtime power, S/N and THD+N fields are signal-dependent model estimates for diagnostics, not laboratory measurements.
